workflow.name: OLEANDER Blender Professional FreeCAD Multi Face Translate

authority_chain.kernel_route: TopoShape.replaceShape / BRepTools_ReShape with sewShape/fix/removeSplitter normalization and shell-to-solid rebuild when required
authority_chain.selector: semantic face-normal selector for +Z, +X and +Y axis-aligned planar faces; no raw FaceN persistence

bounded_scope: rectangular prismatic single-solid FreeCAD/OCCT B-Rep fixtures
semantic +Z, +X and +Y planar faces selected from face normals and re-resolved after dimensional rebuild
+Z face translated tangentially by +3 mm X and +4 mm Y
+X face translated tangentially by +4 mm Y and +3 mm Z
+Y face translated tangentially by +4 mm X and +3 mm Z
each edit replaces target face plus four adjacent faces through BRepTools_ReShape while the opposite face is not replaced
R001 80x50x10 mm and R002 100x60x12 mm both produce valid one-solid six-face B-Rep results
volume is preserved and the opposite face center/area is preserved for all three orientations
R002 envelopes validate as TOP_Z 103x64x12 mm, SIDE_X 100x64x15 mm and SIDE_Y 104x60x15 mm
FCStd plus one STEP artifact per orientation persist and reopen with OLE selector/translation/authority metadata
zero-length translation is rejected before mutation
translation containing a selected-face normal component is rejected before mutation
translation magnitude greater than 20 mm is rejected before mutation
Blender creates three tessellated display-only derivatives and preserves selector vectors, translation vectors, source FCStd hash and authority across .blend save/reopen
invalidation_rule: Invalidate this bounded validation if FreeCAD/OCCT authoritative edits are replaced by mesh-only mutation, semantic normal selectors are replaced by raw FaceN persistence, tangent-plane/failure gates are removed, opposite-face invariants no longer hold, or source authority no longer survives Blender readback.
authority_note: This receipt extends bounded face translation from a +Z-only special case to three axis-aligned planar face orientations. It does not prove arbitrary oblique planar or nonplanar direct editing and does not promote P0-B or OLEANDER Blender to default professional parity.
